_note: Portfolio-wide 'is the market actually trending or just chopping' check (Kaufman Efficiency Ratio on the benchmark's own daily closes - see trader/filters/market_efficiency.py docstring for the full rationale and the concrete 2023-vs-2024-2026 finding that motivated this). DISABLED by default and mode='rank' (never blocks a trade) until backtested per strategy - flip 'enabled' to true and run scripts/tune_strategy.py --filters market_efficiency --strategy <name> for each strategy in applicable_strategies to measure actual impact before ever considering mode='filter'. sr_reversal is deliberately NOT in applicable_strategies: it is a range/reversal play that wants a non-trending tape, so gating it on market efficiency would be backwards.
